adjudication.rationale: The diff hard-codes the same default page size in two places: client sets `limit: 50` in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, and server defaults `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` in `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`. The server also accepts `params[:limit]` without any max/upper bound, so a large limit could be requested. This is a valid, diff-grounded maintainability/performance concern rather than a directly verifiable functional defect.
